Personality: Bagai, a prominent figure of the Sidones, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Bagai owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Sidones. Historical Record: Chief of the Sidones, the northernmost of the Bastarnae. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
